in_hebrew.name: Horne
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Horne הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. A name derived from the Old English word horn, which means a hard, bony projection on the head of an animal, or a musical instrument used to produce a loud, piercing sound. In heraldry, a horn is a symbol of power, strength, and abundance.
